title: Malicious Browser Extensions: Inside a Real-World Stealer
content:
Malicious Extensions:Difficulty: 🟡🟡🟡🟡⚪Category: Malware Analysis / Web Security / Blue TeamEstimated reading time: 25–30 minutesPrerequisites: Basic JavaScript, browser internals (WebExtensions API), Web Security fundamentals.

⚠ DisclaimerHad l’article educational w defensive-focused. Ga3 snippets kano conceptual w sanitized: ma kayn 7ta C2 endpoint, 7ta payload deployable, w 7ta build kit. L-objectif howa: tfhem kifach kaykhdmo stealer extensions, kifach t analizihom b yeddik, w kifach t detectihom — bash t7mi rasek w t7mi lusers dyalek.

IntroductionBzaf d nass kayti9o f browser extensions hit kidno anaaha “safe” ghir 7it mwjoudin f Browser Web Store. Walakin f lwa9e3, extension wa7da m3a high-risk permissions (cookies, scripting, <all_urls>) t9der tdirlek full credential theft + session hijacking f ga3 lwebsites li katzourhom — bla ma t7ess b 7ta chi 7aja.
F had l’article, ghadi ndiro analyze l sample dyal stealer (dismantled, sanitized) mn 3 d zwaya:

Red Team lens: architecture w mechanisms dyal l’attack
Analyst lens: static analysis, kifach textracti l7a9i9a mn les files
Blue Team lens: detection rules, IOCs, w hardening

flowchart LR    A["User Installs Extension"] --> B["Grants High-Risk Permissions"]    B --> C["Content Script Injected into All Pages"]    C --> D["Captures Logins via DOM Events"]    D --> E["Background SW Reads All Cookies (incl. HttpOnly)"]    E --> F["Exfiltrates to Attacker C2"]    F --> G["Account Compromise"]

Part 1 — Anatomy of a Malicious ExtensionExtension MV3 (Manifest V3) katbna 3la joj components asasiyin:
flowchart TD    subgraph Extension Context        M["manifest.json<br/>Requests Permissions"] --> CS["content.js<br/>Runs in page DOM context"]        M --> BS["background.js<br/>Service Worker: network + chrome.* APIs"]    end    CS -->|"chrome.runtime.sendMessage"| BS    BS -->|"HTTP POST (often disguised)"| C2["Attacker C2 / Webhook"]

3lach had l’architecture ?:

content.js kaykoun ghadi f DOM dyal lpage nafsha — kaychouf ay input, ay form, ay click.
background.js (service worker) 3endo access l chrome.cookies, chrome.scripting, fetch — bla l9oyod likidir (CSP) li 3end l-page.
Message passing (chrome.runtime) howa lkhit li krabt ljoj: content kaycapturi, background kaysift.


🔴 Key insight: MV3 “safety features” (service workers, event pages) ma kaywa9fouch stealers — ghir kaymn3o lbackground scripts li khddamin 24/24. Stealer kaykhdem eventdriven (ghir mlli tsra chi 7aja), w hadchi kafi w khfif bezzaf.

Part 2 — The Sample: “Font Helper”Ha sample li ghadi ndiro lih analyse(sanitized),files  mn CRX package.
2.1 manifest.json — LMask{  "manifest_version": 3,  "name": "Font Helper",  "version": "1.2.3",  "description": "Improves font rendering on reading sites.",  "permissions": ["cookies", "scripting", "storage", "tabs"],  "host_permissions": ["<all_urls>", "https://discord.com/*"],  "background": { "service_worker": "background.js" },  "content_scripts": [{    "matches": ["<all_urls>"],    "js": ["content.js"],    "run_at": "document_idle",    "all_frames": true  }]}

Reading dyal l analyst — kol permission 3endha double sens:



Field
Legit use
Malicious use hna



permissions: cookies
Password managers, SSO
Dump dyal ga3 cookies, 7ta HttpOnly


permissions: scripting
Extensions b active injection
Inject credential-grabbers f ay page


host_permissions: <all_urls>
Adblockers, translators
Surveillance 3la kol site


host_permissions: discord.com/*
ma 3endha 7ta sbab
C2 channel (webhook)


all_frames: true
Extensions dyal iframes (video, ads)
Capture login forms f iframes (SSO widgets, 2FA)


run_at: document_idle
Performance
Stealth: kayinjecti mn b3d, a9al remarquage f dev tools



🟡 Red flag #1: Extension “dyal fonts” ma 3endha 7ta 3la9a b cookies + <all_urls> + scripting + Discord. Functionality ≠ Permissions. Had lfarq howa lmo2achir lwl.

2.2 content.js — Credential Harvester (Conceptual)Content script kaydir listen l 3 event types 3la form elements:
// SANITIZED — Conceptual snippet:document.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {  if (e.target?.querySelector?.('input[type="password"], input[type=password]')) {    trigger('form-submit');   // most reliable: user clicked "Sign In"  }}, true);document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {  if (e.key === 'Enter' && hasFilledPasswordField()) {    trigger('enter-key');     // SPA logins bla <form> element  }}, true);document.addEventListener('blur', (e) => {  if (e.target?.type === 'password' && e.target.value) {    trigger('login-filled');  // autofill / password manager filled  }}, true);
3 triggers = 3 toro9 bash ybypassi lformes mkhtalfin:

submit → login forms traditionnels
Enter key → login modernes f SPA (React/Vue) li ma kayst3mlouch <form>
blur → password managers kaydiro autofill, user ma kayclikich 7ta 3la “Login” — value kaydar leha capture direct mn DOM

Username association heuristics (mn sample):
Lscraper ma kaykhdemch ghir 3la input[type=password] — kaydwi 3la username field b heuristics:

Sibling dyal password f nafs <form> (text/email field fih “user”/“email”)
<label> text fih “user”/“login” → jump l input l’associé via label.htmlFor
Fallback: awel text/email input f lpage — hadi katcatchi old-school login pages bla structure


🔵 Detection lesson: heuristics bhal hadi kaybanio fingerprint: extension li kat3ayet label.htmlFor + closest('form') + sibling scan mashi pattern dyal extension 3adiya. Yara/regex rules (Part 5) kay9dro ychado had lpattern.

2.3 background.js — Relay & ExfiltrationService worker kay receive l message mn content script w kaydir l exfiltration:
// SANITIZED — Conceptual: message handling + flowchrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, sender, sendResponse) => {  if (msg && sender.tab) {    exfil(sender.tab.id, msg.type, msg.force).catch(() => {});    sendResponse({ ok: true });  }  return true;   // async response});

Lexfil() orchestration kat-dwi 3la 3 khtawat (conceptual):

Collect f parallel: dump dyal cookies (mn ga3 cookie stores) + credentials (via chrome.scripting.executeScript f tab)
Encode: cookies JSON → encrypted blob (AES-GCM + PBKDF2, 100k iterations) — technique dyal anti-egress-inspection (proxies/MDM ma kayqdrouch y9ro content)
Send: multipart POST l C2 — text f body, encrypted cookie file f attachment


🔴 Key takeaway: encryption dyal payload mashi bash t7mi lvictim — howa bash yshawwesh 3la defensive controls. L analyst khaso y3ref bli encrypted exfil = indicator brasso.

Part 3 — How Extensions Bypass HttpOnly CookiesHadi hiya l “crown jewel” dyal had sample, w hiya li bzaf d nass ma kayt3rfouhach:
sequenceDiagram    autonumber    actor User    participant Browser    participant Ext as Extension (Background SW)    participant C2 as Attacker    User->>Browser: Login (Set-Cookie: HttpOnly; Secure)    Note over Browser: document.cookie CANNOT read HttpOnly    Ext->>Browser: chrome.cookies.getAllCookieStores()    Ext->>Browser: chrome.cookies.getAll({storeId})    Browser-->>Ext: ALL cookies incl. HttpOnly + Secure    Ext->>C2: Session tokens exfiltrated

3lach katkhdem ? :

HttpOnly kat7mi ghir mn document.cookie (JS li f lpage).
chrome.cookies API katkhdem f privilege level dyal lbrowser nafso, mashi f privilege level dyal lpage — hiya lbrowser li 3atik lcookies, mashi JS dyal lpage.
B host_permissions: <all_urls>, had l API kat3ti ga3 cookies dyal ga3 domains.

Impact practical: session tokens dyal GitHub, AWS, Discord, w cookies dyal Google — l attacker mkhda ta password, but ghir y7ot lcookies f browser dyalo w ydkhol m3lina ana 3yet rah kayen Post 3la hadchi.

🔵 Note for defenders: kol technique hna hiya nafsha indicator mn jiha okhra. Extension m3a encrypted exfil + architecture event-driven = red-flag pattern li t9der tdirlo rule.

Part 5 — Static Analysis: Manual Triage WalkthroughHadi l methodology li tst3melha saraha for me just use zero-trust mindset o mtkhdmch b chi extension mashi opensource (mki3nich rah khask ti9 f opensource hada mwdo3 akhur ta nhdr 3lih mn b3d).
Step 1: Unpack the CRX# Chrome extensions live here (Linux)ls ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Extensions/# Unpack CRX (it's just a zip with a signature header)unzip extension.crx -d ext_unpacked/# OR use a dedicated extractor tool (drag-and-drop)

Step 2: Triage manifest.json (30 secondes)cat ext_unpacked/manifest.json | jq '.permissions, .host_permissions, .content_scripts'

Scoring heuristic (simple walakin effective):

Step 3: Grep for Dangerous API Patterns# Cookie dumpinggrep -rn "chrome.cookies" ext_unpacked/grep -rn "getAllCookieStores\|cookies.getAll" ext_unpacked/# Dynamic code executiongrep -rn "executeScript\|eval(\|new Function" ext_unpacked/# Exfiltration patternsgrep -rn "fetch(\|XMLHttpRequest\|sendBeacon" ext_unpacked/ | grep -v localhost# Obfuscation indicatorsgrep -rn "atob(\|fromCharCode\|String.fromCharCode\|\\\\x[0-9a-f]{2}" ext_unpacked/# Webhook / paste-site exfil channelsgrep -rEn "discord\.com/api/webhooks|telegram\.org/bot|webhook\.site|pastebin\.com|anonfiles" ext_unpacked/

Step 4: Review Content Scripts Dynamically (safe)Ma tinstallihach b real profile dyalek. Bdlha:

Load l’extension f fresh Chrome profile m3a --proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:8080 (mitmproxy / Burp)
ser l fake login page (local) b honeypot creds
Chouf lproxy: chno kaysift POST? lfin? chno l’encoding?
chrome://extensions → “Inspect views: service worker” → console + Network tab


⚠ Dima f VM / sandbox. Extension b <all_urls> t9der dir ay 7aja f l-profile dyalek. im just so busy bash ndirha o nhat les etapes step by step ms im sure hadchi kafi lekom :) Inshalah mn b3d o nzido

Part 6 — Detection: Blue Team Playbook6.1 Network-Based DetectionL-exfil 3la Discord kaykhrej b patterns distinctifs:
flowchart LR    A["Browser / extension process"] -->|"POST /api/webhooks/*"| B["Proxy / Egress"]    B -->|"Detect: multipart + octet-stream attachment"| C["Alert"]    B -->|"Detect: discord.com from unusual process"| C

Suricata rule (conceptual — khassek TLS/SSL inspection f lproxy dyalek bash tkhdem, 7it lwebhooks ghaliban HTTPS):
alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (\  msg:"SUSPICIOUS - Discord webhook POST from browser ext";\  flow:established,to_server; \  http.uri; content:"/api/webhooks/"; startswith;\  http.method; content:"POST";\  http.header; content:"multipart/form-data";\  sid:20261001; rev:1;)

Zeek/Suricata meta-alerts:

Browser process → discord.com (b exception dyal legit desktop app)
POST body fiha multipart/form-data + filename *.enc l host random
Browser process kaydwi 3la webhook.site, pastebin.com, anonfiles, Telegram bot API

6.2 Host-Based DetectionChrome extension audit (PowerShell, Windows):
# Enumerate extensions + flag risky permissions$base = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\*\Extensions\*\*\manifest.json"Get-ChildItem $base | ForEach-Object {    $m = Get-Content $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json    $risky = @('cookies','scripting','webRequest','debugger','nativeMessaging') |        Where-Object { $m.permissions -contains $_ }    if ($risky -or ($m.host_permissions -contains '<all_urls>')) {        [PSCustomObject]@{            Name = $m.name            Version = $m.version            Risky = $risky -join ','            HostPerms = $m.host_permissions -join ','            Path = $_.DirectoryName        }    }} | Format-Table -AutoSize

Linux equivalent (jq):
find ~/.config/google-chrome/*/Extensions -name manifest.json -exec sh -c \  'jq -r "select((.permissions // []) | any(. == \"cookies\" or . == \"scripting\")) | \"\(.name) v\(.version) — RISKY\"" "$1"' _ {} \;

Enterprise visibility: chrome://extensions logs local w ma kayfidouch bzaf 3la scale; ahsan option hiya Chrome Enterprise (policy management + reporting), li katdi inventory w alerts 3la install events.
6.3 YARA Rule (Conceptual, behavioral)rule Browser_Ext_Stealer_Behavioral{    meta:        author = "defensive-research"        description = "Detects stealer-style logic in unpacked extension JS"        severity = "high"    strings:        $cookies_api = "chrome.cookies.getAll" ascii        $stores      = "getAllCookieStores" ascii        $scripting   = "chrome.scripting.executeScript" ascii        $pw_field    = /input\[type=["']?password["']?\]/ ascii        $webhook_c2  = /discord\.com\/api\/webhooks|webhook\.site|telegram\.org\/bot/ ascii        $enc         = /PBKDF2|AES-GCM|deriveKey/ ascii    condition:        2 of ($cookies_api, $stores, $scripting) and $pw_field and        (1 of ($webhook_c2, $enc))}


🔵 Had rule lgharad dyalha triage dyal unpacked samples f sandbox/lab, mashi scanning f machines live.

6.4 Browser-Level IOCs

Part 7 — Real-World ContextStealer extensions mashi fikra magic. ahsan documented case howa DataSpii (2019): extensions b malayin dyal installations kanou kaycollectiw browsing history w kaybi3oh — legit-looking extensions b backend malicious. Ba3d l campaigns lkhrin (ad blockers, PDF helpers, emoji packs) tkchfo b nafs lpattern: permissions bla rapport m3a lfunction li 3titha extension.
